title: Mushroom and Kale Stew
subtitle: with Warm Garlic Bread
description: Nothing beats the winter blues more than a nourishing bowl of veggies. Load up on mushrooms and kale seasoned with Moroccan spices and scoop up all the delicious sauce with crusty garlic bread.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 180C. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove and halve the remaining clove. Finely chop the onion. Halve the mushrooms. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems, keeping them separate. Remove the tough inner stems from the kale, then finely chop the leaves.

Pan-fry veggies: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion, mushrooms and coriander stems, stirring, for 3 mins or until the onion is starting to soften. Add the crushed garlic and Moroccan seasoning and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until fragrant.

Cook stew: Add 2 tsp tomato paste to the veggies and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Add the tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar (see Kitchen 101) and 180ml (¾ cup) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, for 10 mins or until slightly thickened.

Make garlic bread: Meanwhile, cut the bread rolls in half. Put on an oven tray and bake for 8 mins or until golden. Brush the cut sides of the bread with 2 tsp olive oil and rub with the cut side of the garlic clove.

Serve up: Add the kale to the stew and cook for 3-5 mins until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the stew among bowls, scatter with the coriander leaves and serve with the garlic bread. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Adding a little sugar to the sauce helps to balance the acidity of the tomato paste and tomatoes.
